name: Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation (APU) is a premier private university in Malaysia, originally established in 1993 as the Asia Pacific Institute of Information Technology (APIIT). Over the decades, it has evolved into a leading institution known for its fusion of technology, innovation, and creativity.

APU is highly regarded for its academic excellence, being the first Malaysian university to achieve a "Premier Digital Tech Institution" status from the Malaysia Digital Economy Corporation (MDEC). The university is famous for producing highly skilled graduates who are ready to meet the demands of the global digital economy. It offers a wide range of degrees across diverse disciplines, including Computing, Business, Engineering, and Media, all with technology as a common core.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
At APU, you will experience a truly cosmopolitan environment. The university is ranked No. 1 in Malaysia and No. 16 globally for its international student community, hosting over 13,000 students from 130 different countries. This diversity creates a vibrant, multicultural campus culture where you can engage in various cultural celebrations and events.

You can join numerous student clubs and societies that cater to a wide range of interests, from technical guilds and coding clubs to sports and cultural groups. The university also provides comprehensive support services, including international student guidance and academic counseling, to ensure you feel at home while studying in Malaysia.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
APU offers a variety of managed accommodation options to suit different budgets and preferences. You can choose from on-campus residences or fully-managed off-campus apartments, all of which are designed to provide a safe and comfortable living environment.

Off-campus residences like City of Green (COG), M Vertica, and Maple offer premium facilities such as swimming pools, gymnasiums, and 24-hour security. These apartments are typically shared, featuring 3-4 rooms with a common living area, kitchen, and Wi-Fi. To make commuting easier, the university provides a free shuttle bus service that connects these off-campus locations directly to the main campus.

  1. Library The university provides access to extensive digital medical libraries and research databases. These resources are designed to support your case-based learning and provide the most current evidence for clinical care.
  2. Sports While the campus is focused on intensive medical training, you have access to local fitness centres and outdoor recreational activities in Freeport, including swimming, diving, and coastal sports to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  3. Laboratories WAUSM features world-class simulation laboratories where you can practice clinical skills in a safe, controlled environment. These facilities include high-fidelity mannequins and standardized patient exam rooms to mimic real-world medical scenarios.
  4. Cafeteria The Freeport campus includes dining areas where you can grab fresh meals and beverages between lectures. There are also numerous local cafes and international dining options located within walking distance of the university.

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
1. Library The APU Library provides you with an extensive collection of digital and physical resources. It is designed to be a hub for research and self-study, offering modern study spaces and access to global academic databases to support your coursework and projects.
  2. Sports You will have access to various sporting facilities both on and off campus. Many of the university's partner residences include fitness centers, swimming pools, and courts for badminton, tennis, and futsal. These spaces allow you to stay active and participate in competitive or recreational sports.
  3. Laboratories As a technology-focused institution, APU boasts world-class specialized labs. One of its standout facilities is the APU AI Supercomputing Lab, which allows you to work with cutting-edge technology in artificial intelligence and data science. There are also dedicated labs for Engineering, Cyber Security, and Animation.
  4. Cafeteria The campus features various dining options where you can enjoy a wide range of cuisines, catering to the diverse international student body. From quick snacks at cafes to full meals at the main cafeteria, there are plenty of spaces to relax and socialize between classes.

highlights.title: Campuses
highlights.value:
Kuala Lumpur (Main Campus)

The main APU campus is strategically located in Technology Park Malaysia (TPM), Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur. This location is the heart of Malaysia’s high-tech zone, placing you right next to industry leaders and innovators.

  • Academic focus: This campus houses all major faculties, including Computing, Engineering, Business, and Media.
  • Transport: It is well-connected via major highways and is just under 16 km from the iconic Petronas Twin Towers. The campus is also easily accessible via public transport networks.
  • Student experience: The campus features an iconic "Space University" design with advanced classrooms and social spaces, providing a futuristic learning environment.
